Description: Define the high-level system design, team roles, and technical stack. Document in GitHub README.
Acceptance Criteria: README contains architecture overview; team roles assigned in Jira; tech stack confirmed

Summary: Set up Jira Scrum project and sprints
Description: Create the Jira Scrum project named Cloud Resource Prediction. Configure epics, create sprints, and assign team members.
Acceptance Criteria: Scrum board visible with epics, stories, and 2 sprints configured

Description: Create the GitHub repo 'cloud-resource-prediction', push initial scaffold (folders, README, .gitignore).
Acceptance Criteria: Repo is public; initial commit contains project structure

Description: Source a cloud workload CPU utilization dataset. If unavailable, generate synthetic data using make_data.py. Document the source.
Acceptance Criteria: data/cloud_data.csv exists with columns timestamp/cpu/memory/network; source disclosed in README and report

Description: Load CSV, sort by timestamp, drop duplicates and NaN rows, filter out-of-range values, engineer lag features cpu_lag1 and cpu_lag2.
Acceptance Criteria: Preprocessed dataframe with no NaN; lag features present; shape confirmed in train.py output

Description: Log a persistence baseline (next CPU = current CPU) in MLflow. Record MAE and RMSE.
Acceptance Criteria: MLflow shows a 'baseline_persistence' run with mae and rmse metrics logged

Description: Train Random Forest with (n=50 d=5), (n=100 d=10), (n=200 d=15). Log all parameters and metrics in MLflow. Save best model to models/model.joblib.
Acceptance Criteria: Three RF runs visible in MLflow; models/model.joblib saved; lowest RMSE run identified

Description: Set up MLflow experiment named 'cloud-resource-prediction'. Verify tracking server runs at http://127.0.0.1:5000.
Acceptance Criteria: mlflow ui shows experiment with 4 runs; run comparison works; artifact browser shows saved model

Description: Build app.py using Gradio. Accept 5 numeric inputs (cpu, memory, network, lag1, lag2). Output predicted CPU and recommendation with three tiers.
Acceptance Criteria: app.py launches locally; all three recommendation tiers display correctly for test inputs

Description: Run python app.py and test low/moderate/high input scenarios. Document results in report.
Acceptance Criteria: Three test scenarios (low/moderate/high) produce expected recommendations; screenshots taken

Description: Create a public Hugging Face Space (Gradio). Upload app.py, requirements.txt, models/model.joblib. Verify build succeeds.
Acceptance Criteria: Space URL accessible; app loads without errors; predictions match local results

Description: Write tests/test_model.py with at least 5 test cases: normal, low, high, boundary, batch. All must pass.
Acceptance Criteria: pytest tests/ reports 0 failures; screenshot of passing run taken

Description: Write README.md with project description, dataset disclosure, setup instructions, results table, and future enhancements.
Acceptance Criteria: README is complete and merged to main branch on GitHub

Description: Screenshot: experiment list, run comparison (all 4 runs), parameters/metrics table, and model artifacts panel.
Acceptance Criteria: 4 screenshots saved and inserted into the report

Description: Fill in all chapters of the CPPE template using real MAE/RMSE values, actual screenshots, and honest dataset disclosure. Jenkins noted as future enhancement.
Acceptance Criteria: Report submitted as PDF/Word; all chapters complete; no invented numbers

Description: Screenshot: backlog view, active sprint board, completed sprint, sprint report / burndown chart.
Acceptance Criteria: 4 Jira screenshots included in report Chapter 5
